variables.toolTip: If this is enabled, being inside this volume will affect UDS' Interior Adjustments and UDW's Sound Occlusion, as long as the Occlusion Sampling Mode is set to take these volumes into account.

metaData.tooltip: If this is enabled, being inside this volume will affect UDS' Interior Adjustments and UDW's Sound Occlusion, as long as the Occlusion Sampling Mode is set to take these volumes into account.

variables.toolTip:
If this is enabled, the collision primitive will be automatically configred to block the channel selected on UDW for Weather Particle Collision Channel, so this volume will block rain/snow/dust/debris.
Note if weather particle collision and player occlusion queries use the same trace channel (which they do by default) this option will negate the effect of Blend Radius and Occlusion Multiplier on this volume.
